notes.title: Update Note 2018.03.23
notes.notes:
Hello,

I changed the repeat play difficulty level in arcade mode

It changes so that the movement of enemy throwing objects looks more natural when the arcade mode is repeated

When the stage is cleared, the score has been changed so that the score increases by the number of remaining hearts

Thank you
